gui.guerra_ezuberante.title: GUERRA EZUBERANTE
gui.guerra_ezuberante.author: Author: %s
gui.guerra_ezuberante.home_description: Welcome to the Guerra Ezuberante laboratory! Browse the pages to learn about the character and the mod's plans.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.factions_notice: Each player picks a faction when first joining the world. The choice is saved and only an operator can change it (/ge faccao definir). Friendly fire stays on.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.faction.lulista: Esquerda Lulista — summons, beans, steak and undead troops.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.faction.bolsonaris: Direita Bolsonarista — international allies, money and fictional air strikes.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.faction.missao: Direita Missão — Renan, Arthur and jaguar cavalry.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.faction.esquerda: Esquerda Independente — protests, crowd control and strategic escapes.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.faction.direita: Direita Independente — individual damage, mobility and accuracy.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.faction.centro: Centro — adaptive defense, mobility and support.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.ability.me_respeit: Me Respeita — spinning projectile attack. Not implemented.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.ability.arthur: Arthur do Val — ally summon. Not implemented.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.ability.chad: Modo Chad — transformation with bonuses. Not implemented.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.ability.cavalaria: Cavalaria da Missão — jaguar-mounted troops. Not implemented.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.ability.moggador: Moggador Supremo — ultimate ability. Not implemented.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.about_description: A satirical political combat mod with fictional video-game caricatures. This panel describes the current prototype and clearly identifies future content.
message.guerra_ezuberante.voice_cooldown: Wait %s s before another voice line.
subtitles.guerra_ezuberante.arthur.sao_f: Arthur: São fáceis porque são pobres
gui.guerra_ezuberante.how_to_test: In creative, summon Renan and Arthur with their eggs in the Guerra Ezuberante tab. They stay peaceful. Attacking them in Survival or Adventure triggers retaliation. Right-click for voice lines; K opens this panel.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.renan_details: Leader of the Missão, on the village castle throne. Boss: 300 HP, yellow boss bar and yellow explosive death like the other bosses. TaCZ AK-47 (one shot per second, unlimited ammo for the NPC only); without TaCZ, punches of 4. 64 × 64 skin preserved.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.arthur_details: Faction: Direita Missão. Health: 32 HP. Damage: 5. Status: basic combat implemented. Author skin; scale 0.88, with matching hitbox and eyes.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.renan_combat: Peaceful until provoked. Ranged fire requires line of sight and protects allies. Combat and direct right-click share the voice/phonk playlist; clicking skips, with a 0.5 s cooldown.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.character_descript: Renan and Arthur walk and watch players. They only attack in retaliation against a valid aggressor.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.ucraniana_details: Arthur summon. Default health: 15 HP (configurable). Custom iron-tier sword: 6 nominal damage, with no extra bonus from Arthur.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.ucraniana_combat: Follows and defends her Arthur, shares legitimate targets and retaliates against aggressors. Does not attack Renan, her summoner or sisters from the same Arthur. Emerges visually before fighting; the sword follows her hand.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.arthur_combat: Retaliation and Ukrainian Army implemented: 5 fighters after a 1 s cast, a 35 s interval and default cap of 30 per Arthur. Voice reaction and summon sound preserved. Values are configurable on the server.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.future_characters: Scroll to see the 3D preview. Additional characters and other armies remain planned.
message.guerra_ezuberante.no_audio: No voice lines available for this character.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.arthur_summoner_de: 32 HP, 5 damage, scale 0.88. Unarmed. Summons five fighters every 35 seconds in combat.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.arthur_fighter_det: 32 HP, 5 final damage, scale 0.88. Spawns with Ukrainian Sword; never summons.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.arthur_summoner_co: Cast: 1 s. Articulated emergence: 2.2 s with small unit stagger. Default cap: 30. Permanent Speed I after first successful wave.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.abilities_notice: Retaliation, GeckoLib animations and Ukrainian Army implemented. Other powers remain planned.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.basic_combat_imple: GeckoLib 4: alternating punches, sword, hurt and cast. Hitbox-aware reach and tick-5 impact.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.ukrainian_army_imp: Only Arthur Summoner summons troops. Hands, elbows and knees articulate during emergence before attacks unlock. Arthur Fighter uses a sword.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.arthur_fighter_com: Retaliation, sword strikes and original voices. No summoning speed bonus. GeckoLib 4.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.arsenal: Original GE-P12 pistol: /ge pistola. Left: fire, right: aim, R: reload. Additional TaCZ weapons are available when the optional mod is installed.
commands.guerra_ezuberante.arsenal.unkno: Unknown weapon: %s. Use /ge armamento and press Tab.
commands.guerra_ezuberante.arsenal.unava: Weapon or ammo unavailable in the loaded gunpack: %s.
death.attack.ge_pistol: %1$s was shot by %2$s with a GE-P12
pistol.ge.controls: Left: fire • Right: aim • R: reload
pistol.ge.kit: Loaded GE-P12 and 48 cartridges delivered. Left: fire; right: aim; R: reload.
pistol.ge.hud: LMB: fire  RMB: aim  R: reload
gui.guerra_ezuberante.lula_details: Default health: 300 HP, matching the Wither. Red boss bar: Lula. Neutral until provoked. Articulated belly and original skin.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.lula_combat: Physical bean: 6 damage every 2 s. Every 10 hits taken, 50% chance to answer with a Faz o L; every 7, 30% chance to call a Manifestação. Death: turns red, rises 2 blocks and curls for 3 s before exploding. Power 7; configurable block damage.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.jair_details: Default health: 300 HP, matching the Wither. Green boss bar: Jair Bolsonaro. Bolsonarista faction. Neutral until provoked. Native TaCZ Glock 17; unarmed fallback without TaCZ.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.bolsonaro_implemen: Jair: Glock and Bolsonaro Dynasty. Flávio: terrain-following Rachadinha fissure. Jair and Flávio are allies; no automatic aggression towards players.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.flavio_details: Default health: 30 HP. Bolsonarista faction. Independent from egg; summoned units follow and defend their Jair. Summons vanish when their owner dies.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.flavio_combat: Recurring Rachadinha: 10 damage per activation, 6 s cooldown. Final impact radius: 2.25 blocks, with a larger explosion effect. Punches between abilities; protects allies. Configurable narrow excavation.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.jair_combat: One shot per 20 ticks. Bolsonaro Dynasty: summons one Flávio in combat, 35 s cooldown, limit 3. Green death: rises 2 blocks over 3 s and explodes at power 7. Configurable values.

gui.guerra_ezuberante.faction_select.hin: Click a faction to read its description, then confirm.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.faction_select.war: The choice is saved in this world and only an operator can change it. Friendly fire stays on: members of the same faction can hurt each other. To decide later, use the panel (K) → Factions.

faction.guerra_ezuberante.missao.power.d: summons 2 Ukrainian Fighters that defend you for 30 s. Cooldown 45 s.

faction.guerra_ezuberante.lulista.power2: raising a "6x1" sign, lifts one foot and stamps the ground with a shockwave: non-Lulistas and hostile mobs within 6 blocks take 6 damage, are knocked back and get Slowness II and Weakness for 5 s. Cooldown 20 s.
faction.guerra_ezuberante.lulista.power3: fires a giant L that explodes on whatever it touches with the same blast as Lula's death: breaks blocks and deals 10 area damage. A player of another faction who survives drops 2 inventory items. Cooldown 45 s.
faction.guerra_ezuberante.lulista.power4: 10 petistas fight for you like wolves for 15 s and never attack your faction. Cooldown 45 s.
faction.guerra_ezuberante.esquerda.power: Manifestando
10 comunistas fight for you like wolves for 15 s and never attack your faction. Cooldown 45 s.
Virar o voto

Tabata: the nearest enemy mob (up to 10 blocks) changes sides for 6 s and fights your other enemies. Bosses, creepers and players never change. With no other enemy around, no cooldown is spent. Cooldown 20 s.
Voto de consciência
Tabata: you get 8 extra health (absorption) at once. Cooldown 30 s.
Raízes da Amazônia

Marina: vines hold the enemies within 5 blocks (Paralysed for 3 s), a leaves block grows at the feet of each one and they get a little poisoned. With no enemy around, no cooldown is spent. Cooldown 15 s.
Sumiço de 4 anos
Marina: you turn invisible with Regeneration II for 8 s, and the mobs chasing you lose track of you. Cooldown 60 s.
Pavio curto
Ciro: Strength II and Speed for 5 s and a wave that pushes the enemies within 4 blocks away. Cooldown 12 s.
Vou pra Paris
Ciro: you vanish for 10 s, invisible and untouchable, unable to attack or use powers; mobs lose track of you. You come back with at least half your health. Cooldown 90 s.
Live de 3 horas
Jones: you go live for 3 s; every second, enemies within 8 blocks get Slowness II and Weakness. Cooldown 20 s.
Inverno Siberiano
Jones: the enemy you look at (up to 12 blocks) freezes in place for 4 s, with the powder-snow frost. Without a target in sight, no cooldown is spent. Cooldown 15 s.
Comitê Central
Jones: 3 comrades (Manifestantes with Strength and Resistance) fight for you for 30 s, on top of those from Manifestando. Cooldown 45 s.
power.guerra_ezuberante.turncoat_alone: There is no other enemy for it to fight.

faction.guerra_ezuberante.bolsonarista.p: Strength I, Speed II, Haste II, Jump Boost II and +2 hearts for 15 s. Cooldown 45 s.
opens a 10 × 5 pit, 5 blocks deep, in front of you, breaking everything except bedrock. Anyone in the area takes 10 damage. Cooldown 60 s.
20 pink stones fall from the sky within 7 blocks of you for 5 s; each deals 2 damage to non-Missão players and hostile mobs. Cooldown 30 s.
for 10 s fires 2 yellow books per second where you aim: 1 damage and Bored (no walking or jumping) for 2 s. Cooldown 45 s.
faction.guerra_ezuberante.direita.power2: high leap with no fall damage; landing deals 6 damage to enemies within 4 blocks. Cooldown 15 s.
faction.guerra_ezuberante.direita.power3: pushes enemies within 6 blocks far away and deals 6 damage. Cooldown 20 s.
Resistance IV for 3 s. Cooldown 30 s.
drains 4 health from each enemy within 6 blocks and heals you by the total. Cooldown 30 s.
subtitles.guerra_ezuberante.haddad.perde: Haddad — recording: perdeu né seu tonto
gui.guerra_ezuberante.haddad_details: Default health: 30 HP. Lulista faction, Lula's ally. Patrols the Lulista village like an iron golem and returns to the square if he strays. Defends it: attacks hostile mobs (except creepers) and players of other factions who come close.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.haddad_combat: Face slaps: 3 slaps in a row, 3 damage each; every slap that takes health paralyses the target for 3 s (no walking or jumping). 10 s cooldown; punches between combos. When hurt he plays “tapinhas”; below 20% health, “perdeu né seu tonto”.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.boulos_details: Default health: 60 HP and 6 armor. Lulista faction, Lula's ally. Patrols and defends the Lulista village like Haddad.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.boulos_combat: Melee tank: 5-damage punches, hard to push. No special power yet. When hurt, 40% chance to play “o pó”.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.dilma_details: Default health: 40 HP. Lulista faction, Lula's ally. In the village she keeps watch around the castle; if Lula is attacked she runs to him, and she is the only one who opens the castle's iron door to get in and out. Fights from a distance: keeps 5 to 16 blocks from the target. Near Lula (up to 12 blocks and in sight), a red beam joins them, like the End crystal and the dragon: Lula heals 2 hearts per second and Dilma's attacks are doubled.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.dilma_combat: Cassavas: a fan of 3 every 3 s, 3 damage each. Estocar vento (15 s cooldown, range 12): stretches both arms and turns one clockwise and the other counter-clockwise for 2 s, with a stream of particles to the target; at the end it draws between pushing the enemies in front of her away or leaving them Breathless (air runs out and they take drowning damage for 5 s).
class.guerra_ezuberante.combatente.bonus: +4 max health (2 hearts) and +1.5 melee damage.
class.guerra_ezuberante.combatente.skill: Rushes about 6 blocks where you look; the first enemy in the way takes 6 damage and is knocked back. Cooldown 12 s.
class.guerra_ezuberante.tanque.bonus: +6 armor, +2 armor toughness and 30% knockback resistance.
class.guerra_ezuberante.tanque.skill.des: Enemies within 8 blocks turn on you, and you get Resistance I for 5 s. Cooldown 20 s.
class.guerra_ezuberante.invocador.bonus: +10% speed. Your troops (Ukrainian Army, Protesters and bodyguard) get +25% health and lifetime.
Calls a Protester that follows and defends you for 30 s. Cooldown 30 s.
class.guerra_ezuberante.especialista.bon: -15% faction power cooldowns and +10% power damage (or duration).
class.guerra_ezuberante.especialista.ski: Resets the cooldown of the power selected for B. Cooldown 90 s.
class.guerra_ezuberante.suporte.bonus: +2 max health and light regeneration: 1 health every 5 s after 10 s without taking damage.
class.guerra_ezuberante.suporte.skill.de: Heals 6 health (3 hearts) to you and the players of your faction within 6 blocks. Cooldown 20 s.

entity.guerra_ezuberante.ciro_gomes.back: Ciro Gomes is back from Paris.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.jones_details: Leader of the Independent Left, on the throne of the village castle. A boss: 300 HP, red boss bar and an explosive death like Lula and Jair. Fights with his fists.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.jones_combat: 3-hour livestream (20 s cooldown): stops and lectures for 3 s; every second the enemies within 8 blocks get Slowness II and Weakness. Siberian Winter (15 s cooldown, range 12): freezes the target in place for 4 s, with the powder-snow frost. Central Committee: below half health, calls 3 comrades (Protesters) to fight for him.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.tabata_details: Default health: 30 HP. Independent Left, ally of Jones Manoel. Defends the village and patrols like the golems. Fights with her fists.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.tabata_combat: Changing the vote (20 s cooldown): an enemy mob near her changes sides for 6 s and attacks the other enemies. Bosses, creepers and players never change sides. Conscience vote (30 s cooldown): a hit of 4 or more gives her 8 extra health (absorption).
gui.guerra_ezuberante.marina_details: Default health: 30 HP. Independent Left, ally of Jones Manoel. Defends the village and patrols like the golems. Fights with her fists.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.marina_combat: Amazon Roots (15 s cooldown): vines hold the enemies within 5 blocks for 3 s (Paralysed). Four-year disappearance (60 s cooldown): below 40% health she turns invisible for 8 s, drops the fight, walks away and heals.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.ciro_details: Default health: 40 HP. Independent Left, ally of Jones Manoel. Defends the village and patrols like the golems. The hardest puncher (5 damage).
gui.guerra_ezuberante.ciro_combat: Short fuse (12 s cooldown): when hit he blows up: Strength II and Speed for 5 s and a wave that pushes the enemies within 4 blocks away. Off to Paris (2 min cooldown): below 30% health he leaves the fight and vanishes for 30 s (invisible and untouchable); comes back with half his health.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.eneias_details: Leader of the Direita, on the village castle throne. Boss: 300 HP, blue boss bar and explosive death like Lula, Jair and Jones. Fights from a distance, keeping 5 to 12 blocks from the target.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.eneias_combat: Small bomb (4 s cooldown): thrown in an arc, goes off 1.5 s later, 6 area damage, no blocks broken. Diploma (5 s cooldown): a burst of 3 diplomas, 4 damage each and Slowness. "My name is Enéas!" (30 s cooldown): below half health, when hit, he shouts, throws everyone around back and leaves them with Nausea. "Brazil needs an atomic bomb": at 25% health he turns green, stops and counts 15 s; unless he dies first, he goes off as an atomic bomb that hits everything within 300 blocks and opens an 80-block crater.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.cury_details: Default health: 100 HP. Direita, ally of Enéias. Defends the village; does not fight with his fists.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.cury_combat: In a fight he launches a drone every 2 s until he has 2 shooter drones (they circle the target and fire), 1 regeneration drone (green beam linked to him, heals 2 health per second on him and nearby allies) and 1 bomb drone (dives into the target and explodes, 6 area damage; back 15 s later). The drones vanish when he dies.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.guarda_details: Two on each tower of every faction castle, gun in hand: traficantes de armas for the Lulistas, bolsonaristas, comunistas and direitistas in the villages with villagers of their own, ordinary villagers for the Missão and the Centro. 40 HP, they never leave their post.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.guarda_combat: They shoot everything not of their faction within 20 blocks: players of another faction or none, characters, villagers and troops of other factions and every hostile mob. They spare their own faction, ordinary villagers and animals. With TaCZ each one has one of the 5 TaCZ guns, picked at random; without TaCZ, the mod's GE-P12 pistol (5 damage).
faction.guerra_ezuberante.lulista.power5: Dilma: throws a fan of 3 mandiocas where you look, 3 damage each. Cooldown 6 s.
faction.guerra_ezuberante.lulista.power6: Dilma: arms circling for 1.5 s with the wind ahead; then the enemies in a 12-block cone are pushed away or left without air for 5 s (drawn at random). Cooldown 15 s.
faction.guerra_ezuberante.lulista.power7: Haddad: 3 slaps on the enemy you aim at (up to 4 blocks), 3 damage each; each slap paralyses for 2 s. Without a target, no cooldown is spent. Cooldown 10 s.
faction.guerra_ezuberante.lulista.power8: Boulos: a tank for 8 s: Resistance II and 8 extra health, and enemy mobs within 8 blocks aim at you. Cooldown 30 s.
faction.guerra_ezuberante.direita.power4: Enéias: throws a small bomb in an arc that goes off 1.5 s later: 6 area damage, no blocks broken. Cooldown 8 s.
faction.guerra_ezuberante.direita.power5: Enéias: a burst of 3 diplomas where you look, 4 damage each and Slowness. Cooldown 10 s.
faction.guerra_ezuberante.direita.power6: Enéias: a shout that throws the enemies within 6 blocks back and leaves them with Nausea for 5 s. Cooldown 30 s.
faction.guerra_ezuberante.direita.power7: Augusto Cury: 2 drones circle whoever you hit (or whoever hit you) and fire, 2 damage per shot, for 30 s. Cooldown 30 s.
faction.guerra_ezuberante.direita.power8: Augusto Cury: a drone dives into whoever you hit and explodes, 6 area damage, no blocks broken. Cooldown 20 s.
faction.guerra_ezuberante.direita.power9: Augusto Cury: a drone hovers over you with a green beam and heals 2 health per second on you and the players of your faction within 6 blocks, for 30 s. Cooldown 45 s.
entity.guerra_ezuberante.eneias.nuke: ENÉIAS: BRAZIL NEEDS AN ATOMIC BOMB! Kill him within %s seconds!
faction.guerra_ezuberante.direita.power1: Romeu Zema: appliances (stove, oven, microwave, stereo, TV) rain where you aim, up to 24 blocks: 6 of them, 5 damage each to whoever is close to where it lands, no blocks broken or placed. Cooldown 12 s.

Romeu Zema: privatizes the enemy you aim at (up to 6 blocks): its good effects become yours, and it takes 2 damage and is left paralysed and glowing for 3 s. Without a target, no cooldown is spent. Cooldown 15 s.
Ronaldo Caiado: lassoes the enemy you aim at (up to 14 blocks) and pulls it to you, 2 damage and Slowness II for 2 s. Without a target, no cooldown is spent. Cooldown 8 s.
Ronaldo Caiado: a herd of 5 oxen runs straight where you look for 2 s, running over the enemies (6 damage and a kick upward, once per ox). Cooldown 20 s.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.zema_details: Default health: 100 HP. Direita, Enéias's ally, in the village square. Light blue dress shirt with rolled sleeves and the orange pin of the Novo (skin generated by the mod). Defends the village and fights with his fists (4 damage).
gui.guerra_ezuberante.zema_combat: Clearance sale (8 s cooldown): 6 appliances rain on the target, up to 16 blocks, 5 damage to whoever is close to where each lands, no blocks touched. Privatization (10 s cooldown): up close (6 blocks), takes the target's good effects for himself and leaves it paralysed and glowing for 3 s, with 2 damage.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.caiado_details: Default health: 100 HP. Direita, Enéias's ally, in the village square. Cowboy hat, navy suit, golden buckle and boots (skin generated by the mod). Defends the village and fights with his fists (4 damage).
gui.guerra_ezuberante.caiado_combat: Lasso (6 s cooldown): lassoes a target 4 to 14 blocks away and pulls it to him, 2 damage and Slowness. Agro stampede (15 s cooldown): 5 oxen run straight toward the target, up to 20 blocks, 6 damage and a kick to each enemy run over. The oxen vanish on their own and drop nothing.
faction.guerra_ezuberante.bolsonarista.p: Tarcísio: 5 s of flooding ahead. 2 damage per second, slowness and lost air within 7 blocks; places no real water. Cooldown 20 s.
Tarcísio: the enemy in sight up to 14 blocks gets the bill: 4 damage, weakness and hunger for 8 s. Cooldown 12 s.
Jair Renan: a charge of about 10 blocks in the car he was given; 6 damage and knockback on the way. Cooldown 10 s.
Jair Renan: calls up to 3 protesters to fight for you. Cooldown 25 s.
Eduardo: 4 damage, Weakness II and slowness within 7 blocks. Cooldown 15 s.
Eduardo: you go far away, about 22 blocks, and recover with Regeneration II for 5 s. Cooldown 45 s.
Michelle: the joke about the theory of a vote for Lula. Fires Lula's own explosive giant L, 10 damage. Cooldown 25 s.
Michelle: the cheque heals 6 health and gives absorption to you and allies within 8 blocks. Cooldown 20 s.
Campopiano: the controversial speech deals 3 damage, nausea, weakness and knockback within 6 blocks. 25% chance of backfiring on you. Cooldown 13 s.
Campopiano: 3 s of open mic where you look, damage and slowness in a 9-block cone. Cooldown 15 s.
Nikolas: panic within 10 blocks. 2 damage and nausea; mobs drop the fight and run, players go blind for 2 s. Cooldown 20 s.
Nikolas: 6 s of speed and resistance; at the end, bolts strike up to 3 enemies within 10 blocks, 6 damage each. Cooldown 25 s.
Pavanato: locks the enemy in sight up to 12 blocks in a portable toilet: 2 damage, Paralysed for 3 s and nausea. Cooldown 15 s.
Pavanato: mobs within 12 blocks come at you, you hold for 4 s and then return the slaps: 4 damage and knockback within 3.5 blocks. Cooldown 20 s.
Kim: a straight beam of 16 blocks, up to the first wall; 7 damage to every enemy on the way. Cooldown 11 s.
Kim: the enemy in sight up to 12 blocks loses good effects, takes 3 damage and gets weak and slow at mining for 8 s. Cooldown 15 s.
Guto: films everything. Enemies within 14 blocks glow for 10 s, seen through walls, and are weak for 5 s. Cooldown 15 s.
Guto: a short charge of about 6 blocks; 5 damage on the way. Cooldown 8 s.

faction.guerra_ezuberante.lulista.power1: Janones: allies within 12 blocks get Strength and Speed for 10 s; enemies are slowed for 5 s. Cooldown 25 s.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.tarcisio_freitas_d: Default health: 100 HP. Bolsonaristas, in the village square. Grey suit, blue tie, receding grey hair.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.tarcisio_freitas_c: Flood and Privatized Sabesp, the same pair as the Bolsonarista tree.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.jair_renan_details: Default health: 100 HP. Bolsonaristas, in the village square. Black T-shirt, gold chain, jeans and white sneakers.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.jair_renan_combat: Gifted Car and I'm Number 04, the same pair as the Bolsonarista tree.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.eduardo_bolsonaro_: Default health: 100 HP. Bolsonaristas, in the village square. Beard, red cap, blue blazer and jeans.
Tariff Hike and, at low health, Self-Exile.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.michelle_bolsonaro: Default health: 100 HP. Bolsonaristas, in the village square. Long highlighted hair, pale pink dress and necklace.
Secretly Made the L, the joke about the theory of a vote for Lula, and Micheque, which heals allies.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.eduarda_campopiano: Default health: 100 HP. Bolsonaristas, in the village square. Long brown hair, black blazer and golden cross.
Enemy of Feminists, which may backfire on her, and Unfiltered Podcast.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.nikolas_ferreira_d: Default health: 100 HP. Bolsonaristas, in the village square. Combed fringe, dark blue suit and green tie.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.nikolas_ferreira_c: Pix Fake News, which spreads panic, and The March, which ends in lightning.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.lucas_pavanato_det: Default health: 100 HP. Bolsonaristas, in the village square. Navy polo and beige trousers.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.lucas_pavanato_com: Bathroom Inspector, which locks the target in a portable toilet, and Provocation, which ends in slaps.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.kim_kataguiri_deta: Default health: 100 HP. Missão, in the village square. Black suit and yellow tie.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.kim_kataguiri_comb: Polarization Breaker, a straight beam, and Show Cancelled.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.guto_zacarias_deta: Default health: 100 HP. Missão, in the village square. Short beard, rolled white shirt, party pin and black trousers.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.guto_zacarias_comb: Caught on Camera, which reveals enemies, and TikTok Cut.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.andre_janones_deta: Default health: 100 HP. Lulistas, in the village square. Goatee, red polo with a star and jeans.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.andre_janones_comb: Great Rally, with 8 protesters, and Long Post, which strengthens allies.
power.guerra_ezuberante.fig.alagamento: %s: Flood! But the works were on schedule.
power.guerra_ezuberante.fig.sou_o_04: %s: Do you know who my father is?
power.guerra_ezuberante.fig.autoexilio: %s: Off to the United States. Back whenever.
power.guerra_ezuberante.fig.cancelada: %s was cancelled by her own speech!
power.guerra_ezuberante.fig.caminhada: %s: Nobody lets go on this march!
power.guerra_ezuberante.fig.grande_manif: %s: Calling the people through the networks!
power.guerra_ezuberante.fig.crowd_full: Your protesters are all on the street already.
item.guerra_ezuberante.picanha.desc: It was promised; it costs a gold ingot. Very filling, Strength for 30 s.
item.guerra_ezuberante.cerveja.desc: Speed for 30 s and dizziness for 5 s. Gives the bottle back.
item.guerra_ezuberante.feijoada.desc: Very filling, regenerates for 10 s. Gives the bowl back.
item.guerra_ezuberante.cloroquina.desc: Cures nothing: no health or food back, just dizziness and a little Luck.
item.guerra_ezuberante.megafone.desc: Right click: pushes enemies within 6 blocks. Needs 10 s of breath and wears out.
item.guerra_ezuberante.foice_e_martelo.d: Stronger than an iron sword: the union of two tools.
item.guerra_ezuberante.motosserra.desc: Spending cuts: high damage, slow swing.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.mission.title: General's missions
gui.guerra_ezuberante.mission.goal.kill: Goal: take down NPCs of other parties, %s/%s
gui.guerra_ezuberante.mission.goal.sabot: Goal: break flags of other parties, %s/%s
gui.guerra_ezuberante.mission.goal.guard: Goal: take out soldiers of other parties, %s/%s
gui.guerra_ezuberante.mission.talk: Talk to %s in the village's military base to accept.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.mission.go_back: When done, go back to %s to turn it in.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.abandoned: You gave up the mission. The party will not forget.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.bol_minerio.br: Soldier, the works need iron. Bring the ingots: the opening already has a date, the works we will see about.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.bol_minerio.do: Works delivered! Almost. What matters is the plaque.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.bol_comunistas: There are communists everywhere, even in your backyard. Go take down some NPCs of the other parties.
Our backyard is greener and yellower. For now.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.bol_joias.brie: A very expensive gift from Arabia vanished and nobody knows a thing. Replace the gold before Customs opens the suitcase.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.bol_joias.done: Gold in the vault. If anyone asks, it was a personal gift.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.bol_bandeira.b: Our flag will never be red, and the others should not be standing either. Take down flags of other parties.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.bol_bandeira.d: A patriot tears down other flags and weeps for his own.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.bol_base.title: Operation Enemy Base
mission.guerra_ezuberante.bol_base.brief: Hot tip from the fan pen: their soldiers are slacking. Take some out and end the base's morale.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.bol_base.done: Base weakened. Great day, soldier. Thumbs up.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.bol_cercadinho: The base deserves comfort. Bring diamonds for the fan pen; it is all for freedom, and we will not need the receipt.
The fan pen shines. Now just wave.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.lul_fome.title: Zero Hunger
mission.guerra_ezuberante.lul_fome.brief: Comrade, the people are hungry and wheat does not come from the internet. Bring it to the village kitchen.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.lul_fome.done: Wheat on the table! Now post it on Twitter in all caps.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.lul_picanha.br: The promise was picanha and beer on the weekend. Bring the meat, I will handle the speech.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.lul_picanha.do: The people ate. Promise kept, only a few years late.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.lul_gabinete.b: We fight memes with memes and NPCs with fists. Take down some NPCs of other parties and I will thread it all.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.lul_gabinete.d: It became a 47-post thread. Huge engagement.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.lul_bandeira.b: A rival party's flag is in the square. For democracy, take it down; we will talk about respecting institutions later.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.lul_bandeira.d: Square clean. Democracy thanks you and will not ask who did it.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.lul_base.title: Comrades, to the Base!
mission.guerra_ezuberante.lul_base.brief: The enemy base is small, but its soldiers have real guns. Take some out; we will organise the march later.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.lul_base.done: Victory for the people! The note of repudiation is on its way.
Cash is tight and Haddad is eyeing your pockets. Bring emeralds, it is just a small fee.
Revenue goal met! Haddad sends a hug and a bill.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.mis_live.title: Fuel for the Stream
mission.guerra_ezuberante.mis_live.brief: The stream is past three hours and the generator is dying. Bring coal, the algorithm will not wait.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.mis_live.done: Stream saved. Follow the channel and hit the bell.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.mis_velha_poli: Not Lula, not Bolsonaro, not that other guy. Take down some NPCs of old politics and film it vertically.
The cut is going viral. The party is new, the feud is old.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.mis_servidor.b: The party site is down again, and this time it is the intern's fault. Bring redstone for the server.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.mis_servidor.d: Site is up! Until the next poll.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.mis_bandeira.b: Old parties' flags pollute the view. Take some down and let black and yellow shine.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.mis_bandeira.d: Landscape renewed. Our marketing thanks you.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.mis_base.title: Debating the Soldiers
mission.guerra_ezuberante.mis_base.brief: We tried a debate with their base, but they only answer with gunfire. Take out some soldiers and bring the mic.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.mis_base.done: We won the debate by the opponent's withdrawal.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.mis_vaquinha.b: No campaign fund, so it is crowdfunding. Donate diamonds; you get a public thank-you on the next stream.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.mis_vaquinha.d: Goal reached! Your name will show for three seconds.
Comrade, without base industry there is no revolution, only podcasts. Bring iron for the means of production.
The iron belongs to the people. Now the people just need to find out.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.esq_luta.title: Class Struggle
mission.guerra_ezuberante.esq_luta.brief: We have read all the theory. Now the practice: take down some NPCs of the bourgeois parties.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.esq_luta.done: The contradiction has sharpened. Take this tool, comrade.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.esq_pao.title: Bread, Peace and Land
mission.guerra_ezuberante.esq_pao.brief: Peace and land are for another plan. Today, bring bread for the comrades.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.esq_pao.done: Bread handed out according to need. The committee approved unanimously, after 40 minutes.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.esq_expropriac: Every bourgeois flag is theft. Take some down, in the people's name and with meeting minutes.
Flags expropriated. The minutes run 12 pages.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.esq_palacio.br: Winter has come for their soldiers. Take some out; history will absolve us, and so will the chat.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.esq_palacio.do: The palace trembles, comrade. Or it was just the generator.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.esq_plano.brie: The plan's goal is simple and unrealistic. Bring gold to the people's treasury; we will check in five years.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.esq_plano.done: Goal surpassed on paper. In practice, still debating.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.dir_boi.title: Cattle on the Line
mission.guerra_ezuberante.dir_boi.brief: Agribusiness never stops, but the saddlery did. Bring leather, I will handle the pasture paperwork.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.dir_boi.done: Agro is everything. Even the saddle.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.dir_posse.brie: People of another party are on our land, flags and all. Fix it by taking down some of their NPCs.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.dir_posse.done: Land repossessed. Registry is closed, a mere detail.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.dir_imposto.br: Tax is theft, but the voluntary party contribution is mandatory. Bring gold.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.dir_imposto.do: Thanks for your spontaneous, compulsory donation.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.dir_bandeira.b: Other flags on our land are unfair competition. Take some down, the market will adjust.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.dir_bandeira.d: The invisible hand thanks you, and left no prints.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.dir_base.title: Spending Cuts
mission.guerra_ezuberante.dir_base.brief: An enemy soldier is an expense for their state. Take some out and help slim down the machine.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.dir_base.done: Machine slimmed. Their deficit, our party.
We will privatize even the wind. Bring emeralds to the auction; the notice comes later.
Auction done! Take the chainsaw, it always helps.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.oficial_centro_det: Default health: 100 HP. Centro, in the village's military base. Grey suit, grey tie, grey opinions.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.oficial_centro_com: No powers of his own: only fists, and the Centro's missions.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.cen_emenda.bri: Nobody knows where it comes from or where it goes. Bring gold for the amendment and ask no questions.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.cen_emenda.don: Amendment passed. The minutes got lost.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.cen_apoio.brie: We support any government, preferably the next one. Take down some NPCs of whoever may lose the election.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.cen_apoio.done: Support given. If asked, we were always with the winner.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.cen_ministerio: Governability has a price. Bring emeralds; the ministry does not even need a purpose.
Ministry created. We will pick a name later.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.cen_neutralida: We are neither for nor against, quite the opposite. Take down flags of other parties, with full impartiality.
Nothing personal. Nor political. Nor anything.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.cen_governabil: Other people's soldiers get in the way of talks. Take some out and bring the deal.
Deal closed. Both sides think they won.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.cen_fundao.bri: The fund is sacred and never enough. Bring diamonds to secure the next election, whoever it is for.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.cen_fundao.don: Fund topped up. Until the next coalition.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.rival.lulista: Comrade, this is only for those who make the L. Switch sides and I will give you a mission.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.rival.bolsonar: No works for communists here. I only hand out missions to our side.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.rival.missao: You are still in old politics. Join the party and then we will talk.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.rival.esquerda: I would have a plan for you, if you were in my party. And I will not repeat myself.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.rival.direita: Get off my property. Missions here are only for our crowd.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.rival.centro: No problem at all, as long as you switch parties. We have no prejudice here, only a price list.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.feed.parody: Parody: fictional posts written for the game.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.feed.empty: Nothing here yet. Finish a general's mission and see the reaction.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.flavio.0: Proud of our people. God, country and family.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.flavio.1: Another win! Already sent it to the family group.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.tarcisio.0: Another delivery. The works stay on schedule.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.tarcisio.1: That is management: less talk, more plaques.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.jair_renan.1: This one came as a gift, folks.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.eduardo.0: I will tell them about it in the United States.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.michelle.0: Glory to God for another win.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.michelle.1: We prayed hard for this, brothers and sisters.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.campopiano.0: Feminists, this one is for you.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.campopiano.1: They will cancel me for this too. That is fine.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.nikolas.0: I made a video about it. 200 million views already.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.nikolas.1: Share it before they delete it!
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.pavanato.0: I filmed it all. Going on Reels.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.lula.0: Comrades, the people will eat picanha again.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.lula.1: Never before in the history of this server.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.janones.0: Read the thread. It is just 47 posts.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.haddad.0: I ran the numbers: the tax still stands.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.haddad.1: It was close, but the spreadsheet balanced.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.boulos.0: We occupied it. And we are not leaving.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.boulos.1: The people on the street is something else.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.dilma.0: When we reach the goal, we double the goal.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.dilma.1: Stocking victory is a great achievement.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.jones.0: I wrote a three-hour thread on this, comrades.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.jones.1: The struggle goes on in today's stream.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.tabata.0: One more figure for my public policy spreadsheet.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.marina.0: I vanished for a while, but I came back to celebrate.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.ciro.0: I warned you. The plan has been written for 20 years.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.ciro.1: I will not repeat myself. Off to Paris.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.caiado.0: Cattle on the line, mission done.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.caiado.1: That is how it goes on my pasture.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.cury.0: Manage the emotion of this win.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.cury.1: There is a chapter on this in my book.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.renan.0: I said it first. It is on video.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.renan.1: We will beat everyone, even those who have not shown up.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.arthur.0: Mom, I told you! Look at that.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.arthur.1: I went and filmed it. Link in bio.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.guto.1: I filmed it all, it is on my profile.
x.guerra_ezuberante.author.oficial.0: No comment. Neither for nor against.
x.guerra_ezuberante.react.missao.0: @%s is old politics with a new filter.
x.guerra_ezuberante.react.missao.1: I will make a video about @%s.
x.guerra_ezuberante.react.esquerda.0: @%s is just another agent of capital.
x.guerra_ezuberante.react.direita.0: Who will foot the bill for @%s?
x.guerra_ezuberante.react.centro.0: We can talk, @%s. Everything has a price.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.mission.recruit_lo: Recruit: 4 missions and the moral bar in your party.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.mission.goal.castl: Goal: take down the defenders of a rival castle
mission.guerra_ezuberante.recruit.not_al: Your moral bar must be in your party, after 4 missions.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.recruit.full: You already have all the recruits you can lead.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.no_castle: No rival castle standing in this world.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.castle_fell: The %s castle has fallen! Get away: demolition starts in 5 seconds.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.bol_castelo.br: Soldier, intelligence (the family group chat) found an enemy castle. Take down the defenders and the rest falls by itself.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.bol_castelo.do: Castle down. Great day, soldier. I will unveil the plaque.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.lul_castelo.br: Comrade, it is time for the great march. Take down the castle's defenders; we call it a peaceful occupation.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.lul_castelo.do: Castle occupied! The thread is written, 200 posts.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.mis_castelo.br: We will break the polarization literally. Take down the castle's defenders and film it vertically.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.mis_castelo.do: It fell. The cut has more views than the party has votes.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.esq_castelo.br: I wrote this plan twenty years ago and nobody read it. Take down the defenders and the castle follows. I will not repeat myself.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.esq_castelo.do: I warned you it would fall. Off to Paris to celebrate.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.dir_castelo.br: Someone else's castle on good land is unproductive. Take down the defenders and the repossession comes with explosives.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.dir_castelo.do: Area cleared. Now we can plant soybeans.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.cen_castelo.br: Nothing against the castle. Nor for it. But the bloc wants the space. Take down the defenders, without any bias.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.cen_castelo.do: Castle down, with full neutrality. The space has a new owner.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.intel.lulista: Intel: 8 soldiers on the towers, 4 in the base. Lula on the throne: when hurt he throws the L and calls protesters. Dilma guards the gate.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.intel.bolsonar: Intel: 8 soldiers on the towers, 4 in the base. Jair on the throne opens fissures and calls Flávio. Avoid standing in line with him.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.intel.missao: Intel: 8 soldiers on the towers, 4 in the base. Renan on the throne has a rifle: break line of sight and close in.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.intel.esquerda: Intel: 8 soldiers on the towers, 4 in the base. Jones on the throne streams and calls the Central Committee: do not fight in the square.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.intel.direita: Intel: 8 soldiers on the towers, 4 in the base. Enéias on the throne threatens the bomb: you have seconds to bring him down when he announces it.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.intel.centro: Intel: 8 soldiers on the towers, 4 in the base. The throne is empty, as usual. Take down the soldiers and the castle is yours.
x.guerra_ezuberante.castle.lulista: It was a coup! The castle belonged to the people. Comrades, to the streets.
x.guerra_ezuberante.castle.bolsonarista: Fraud! This castle did not fall, it was toppled. Camp at the barracks.
x.guerra_ezuberante.castle.missao: The castle fell, but engagement rose. We carry on.
x.guerra_ezuberante.castle.esquerda: The bourgeoisie won this battle. See you on the three-hour stream.
x.guerra_ezuberante.castle.direita: Who will pay for this castle? Insurance does not cover communism.
x.guerra_ezuberante.castle.centro: We regret what happened. And we support who did it. And who fell.
item.guerra_ezuberante.biblia.desc: Right click: calls 3 angels who fight for you. 30 s cooldown, up to 6 angels at a time.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.cabo_daciolo_detai: Default health: 300 HP. Of no party, in his enormous church, Bible in hand. Only fights those who provoke him.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.cabo_daciolo_comba: Calls 3 angels every 15 s of a fight and shouts "Glória a Deus!" in chat. When he dies he drops the Bible, which calls angels for whoever takes it.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.mission.goal.bible: Look for the enormous church. Bible: %s/%s
mission.guerra_ezuberante.bol_biblia.bri: Soldier, God is on our side, but the Bible is with Cabo Daciolo. Go to his church and bring it. He will shout, angels will come down and I sign nothing.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.bol_biblia.don: The Bible is yours. Glory to God and to the opening.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.lul_biblia.bri: Comrade, there is a corporal with a Bible that calls angels. We want that caucus on our side. Get it at his church and post it in all caps.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.lul_biblia.don: BIBLE IN THE PEOPLE'S HANDS! Read the thread.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.mis_biblia.bri: A guy with a Bible summoning angels makes great clips. Go to Daciolo's church, take the Bible and film it vertically.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.mis_biblia.don: Most watched video on the channel. Keep the Bible, it is your pay.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.esq_biblia.bri: I predicted Daciolo twenty years ago. Go to his church and bring the Bible. What to do with it is in my plan, page 400.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.esq_biblia.don: There it is. Nobody read the plan, but the Bible is yours.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.dir_biblia.bri: There is an enormous church, no deed, with a corporal inside. Take his Bible, an undervalued asset.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.dir_biblia.don: Asset recovered. Keep it: angels cost less than security.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.cen_biblia.bri: The Corporal belongs to no party, and that worries us. Go to his church and bring the Bible. Then we talk about a ministry for the angels.
mission.guerra_ezuberante.cen_biblia.don: Keep the Bible. The bloc now talks to heaven too.
